title: PhysReflect: Geometry and Perception Guided Diffusion for Physically-Plausible Mirror Reflections
abstract: arXiv:2609.23442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models generate high-quality images, yet often violate the physical laws governing mirror reflections. Reflections often suffer from geometric aberrations, including positional offsets, directional misalignment, proportional imbalance, and structural distortion. These failures remain evident even in contemporary state-of-the-art generative systems. Existing methods itigate this problem through synthetic data scaling or auxiliary depth conditioning, yet their merely reliance on latent-space noise reconstruction losses as implicit supervision prevents direct enforcement of reflection-specific geometric and perceptual constraints. To bridge this gap, we present PhysReflect, a geometry and perception guided diffusion framework that decodes the predicted clean latent into pixel space at each training step and applies annealed supervision through two complementary differentiable objectives. translated_title: PhysReflect：面向物理合理镜像反射的几何与感知引导扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型能够生成高质量的图像，但常常违反支配镜像反射的物理定律。反射往往存在几何畸变，包括位置偏移、方向错位、比例失衡和结构扭曲。即使在最先进的当代生成系统中，这些失败依然明显存在。现有方法通过合成数据扩展或辅助深度条件化来缓解这一问题，但它们仅仅依赖潜空间噪声重建损失作为隐式监督，无法直接施加针对反射的几何和感知约束。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了PhysReflect，一个几何与感知引导的扩散框架，它在每个训练步骤将预测的干净潜变量解码到像素空间，并通过两个互补的可微目标施加退火监督。其中几何损失强制执行镜像诱导的（摘要内容截断于此）
tldr: PhysReflect提出了一种几何与感知引导的扩散框架，通过在每个训练步骤将预测的干净潜变量解码到像素空间，并利用两个互补的可微目标进行退火监督，直接施加反射特定的几何与感知约束，从而生成物理合理的镜像反射。
en_tdlr: PhysReflect proposes a geometry and perception guided diffusion framework that decodes the predicted clean latent into pixel space at each training step and applies annealed supervision through two complementary differentiable objectives, directly enforcing reflection-specific geometric and perceptual constraints for physically-plausible mirror reflections.
